environment.fixture: isolated authenticated loopback sshd with forced test helper and TCP disconnect proxy

scenarios.name: running-cancel
scenarios.details: Observed remote helper PID marker after authentication, then cancelled context; OperationCancelled within 3 seconds.

scenarios.name: running-timeout
scenarios.details: Remote execution marker observed before deadline; OperationTimedOut within 3 seconds after expiry.

scenarios.name: established-disconnect
scenarios.details: Closed both sides of proxy only after remote execution marker; RemoteUnavailable within 3 seconds.

scenarios.name: fixture-cleanup
scenarios.details: Explicitly killed remote helper and checked it was reaped; closed proxy connections and stopped sshd. Three repeated runs, no race or skip.

limitations: The running task is an sshd forced helper to make timing deterministic; actual Git argv, output and host keys are covered by existing TestOpenSSHIntegration.
Local SSH cancellation does not guarantee remote task termination. Fixture cleanup is explicit and independent.
Only isolated loopback transport was measured; this is not a WAN/authentication compatibility test.
